ABOUT THE WATER PROGRAM

Adrenaline, organised properly.

From foaming white water to open-throttle jet ski runs, Hydra Sports & Tourism plans, guides and safety-checks every water adventure — so you can focus on the ride.

  • Guided white water rafting on graded river routes

  • Boat and backwater excursions for groups
